name: clarify
description: Decide whether to interrupt the user with a question, then ask it so it takes one click to answer. Sweeps the conversation, the repo and earlier agent output for the answer, kills questions whose answer would not change the work, then refers every surviving technical fork to another model family before the user sees it — Opus at xhigh, Gemini Argon at medium or Grok at xhigh, each resolved at run time to the newest model its CLI offers, all three as a panel for genuinely open forks, and Dossier deep research for questions about the world. A fork whose axis is yours is one you settle and report, not one you ask; what reaches the user is taste, cost, scope, risk and anything irreversible, as one batched AskUserQuestion with two options and no recommendation to nudge them. Treats a note attached to an answer as binding. Ships a deterministic linter that enforces the invariant.
